summary.title: The Developer Marketing Guide (Heavybit)
summary.one_liner: Six agent-ready developer marketing skills (launches, positioning, content, community, DevRel, onboarding/docs) drawn from the Heavybit library, run through an MCP server.
keywords: how to market a developer tool
takeaways: The guide offers six skills covering product marketing, messaging and positioning, content marketing, developer communities, DevRel strategy, and onboarding and documentation.
Each skill is built from Heavybit talks, podcasts and articles and turned into instructions an AI agent follows.
To use them, add the Crucible MCP server to an MCP client such as Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT and sign in with Google or GitHub (free, nothing to install).
The guide started in 2015 with three Heavybit talks on content types, distribution plans, and community projects and retargeting.
summary.summary: The page describes a set of six developer marketing skills from the Heavybit library, each based on talks, podcasts and articles by practitioners. Each skill is run by an AI agent via an MCP server (Crucible), which asks about the product and audience, works through decisions, and cites library pieces. The page covers setup steps, a meetup-planning component tied to Heavybit's virtual developer events, and the 2015 origins of the guide. It is mostly a landing page for the skills, so specific methods within each skill are not detailed.
